Predeclared forced exits create intents only; execution still needs an eligible exact quote. Ridge fixed-hold and hysteresis have unavailable intermediate marks, explicitly excluding exact continuous drawdown/risk claims. Declared rollover costs are now actually applied to held positions, unlike the previous narrower cohort. Runtime binaries, bulk archive, credentials and live state are excluded; no cloud-sync claim. Routine use is the frozen operator recipe, never regeneration to bypass refusal.
